Add to Your Home Screen

Your custom home-screen app icon is embedded in this file. Download it below to host on Netlify Drop or GitHub Pages.

This dashboard is a single self-contained HTML file. Download it to host on a free static site (like Netlify Drop or GitHub Pages) or open it locally, then pin it to your phone:

iPhone / iPad (Safari)

Open your hosted link in Safari, tap the Share icon, then tap Add to Home Screen.

Android (Chrome)

Open your hosted link in Chrome, tap the ⋮ menu, then tap Add to Home screen.
